messages:
sophia martinez: Hi everyone — first week here! Quick question: I need a sandbox in EU (eu-west1) for running experiments that must stay in-region for data residency. Who handles ensuring the project and storage are EU-only? Also I heard AWS cross-account roles require MFA for console access — true?

dylan cho: welcome sophia :wave: For GCP residency, we put the project under the redwood-eu-data billing account and set bucket/location to EU. Tag infra and finance to create a project with org policy restricting multi-region exports.

harpreet kaur: re AWS MFA: yes, assume-role for CLI is fine without MFA but console access to the cross-account role usually requires an SAML session or explicit MFA if the target account policy enforces it. For your tests we normally give CLI assume-role access only.

infra-bot: Access request opened (#AR-6010): Create project redwood-eu-sophia-1 under redwood-eu-data; enable org policy restricting resource locations to europe-west1/europe-west2; grant storage.admin (project-scoped) and compute.viewer. Approvers: infra, finance.

sophia martinez: thanks! Can someone confirm the labels/annotations finance wants for EU projects? I want to set them during creation.

finance-notify: Finance tag guidelines: labels required - cost_center=eng-research, data_region=eu, owner=sophia.martinez. Also add billing_code=eu-experiments if this is research credit.

dylan cho: once AR-6010 is approved, infra will DM instructions. For AWS we'll add you to the assume-role ARN for eu-testing accounts; use CLI `aws sts assume-role` and no extra MFA step for CLI unless explicitly requested.

sophia martinez: perfect, appreciate the quick answers. I'll finish the onboarding checklist and wait for AR-6010. :white_check_mark:
